BEGIN;

DELETE FROM target_prerequisite
WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version, prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version) IN (
    ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1')
);

DELETE FROM learning_goal_target
WHERE goal_code = 'programming.foundation' AND goal_version = 'v1';

DELETE FROM learning_target
WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
    ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1')
);

DELETE FROM learning_goal_version
WHERE goal_code = 'programming.foundation' AND version = 'v1';

COMMIT;
